residuum columbarum profluvio laborantium, & columbarum puerperarum, ut & (oblationum) pro peccato & reatu, possunt ad spontaneam oblationem adhiberi. page.notes: The Hebrew line ends and beginnings are cut off at the left edge of this part, so many words are incomplete; the remainder of the page is not included. Several readings are uncertain where the print is faint or broken, and the line-initial letters that fall in the cut are not transcribed. The strip is very narrow and the letters at the left edge are partly cut away, so the readings of the line ends are doubtful and marked [?]. The repeated word מותר is read as it appears on each line; the exact count may be off by one or two. Right and left edges are cut or blanked; the text is a fragment. The marks (9), (10), (11), (12) are reference numbers in the text. Greek-less page; the faint text at the very bottom is a digitiser's mark and was left out.
